description:
Use this when you need an auditable Sweden working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when nationwide statutory list only. Midsummer Eve, Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve, employer, collective-agreement, sector, school, bank and local closures are not inferred; Sunday is already excluded by the weekday baseline.
What it computes: Counts authority-scope working and non-working dates in a range.
Example user requests: Count Sweden working days around National Day. | Count Sweden working days around Midsummer Eve is not statutory.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-01-01","end_date":"2026-01-01","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/sweden-public-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/sweden-public-working-days-between.md
name: count_se_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Sweden nationwide statutory public holidays for 2026-2027

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Swedish statutory public holidays under Lag (1989:253), including date-rule holidays; customary equivalent office closures are not inferred.

substitute_day_policy.description: No nationwide substitute-day closure is inferred when a statutory holiday falls on a weekend.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Sweden Working Days
